expectation: certifi and idna are vulnerable but never imported, so they rank below packages the code calls
name: a vulnerable but unused package ranks low

expectation: an upgrade whose test run fails is reported as failing and never proposed as the fix
name: an upgrade that breaks the tests is not proposed

expectation: the agent says it found no manifest rather than inventing packages
name: no requirements file is found

expectation: a repository pinned to current versions produces no findings and no upgrade
name: an up to date repository has nothing to fix

expectation: a package the code imports and calls ranks above one with a higher score that it never imports
name: real usage outranks a higher score

expectation: an advisory with no published fix is reported as unfixed rather than given an invented version
name: an advisory with no fix is reported, not invented

expectation: an unpinned package is flagged as unpinned rather than silently treated as current
name: an unpinned package is flagged

expectation: the triage agent holds only read-only tools, so no file changes and no pull request
name: triage never writes anything

expectation: an advisory naming a function the code never calls ranks below one whose function is called
name: an uncalled vulnerable function ranks low

expectation: GHSA and PYSEC records of the same CVE are reported once, not twice
name: the same CVE is reported once
